Structured Seating: Cortech Structured Seating Beam Seating System
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-structured-seating-connected-beam-seating
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/structured-seating/
Spec sheets: Structured Seating, Floor glide installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Structured Seating Connected Beam Seating System
Current H1: Cortech Structured Seating - Connected Beam Seating System - Rotationally Molded Design
Subtitle: Molded Polyethylene Beam Seating in 1 to 4 Seats for Lobbies, Waiting Rooms, and Dayrooms
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Structured Seating Connected Beam Seating
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Structured Seating Connected Beam Seating System is a beam-mounted seating system for waiting rooms, lobbies, dayrooms, and other common areas in correctional, behavioral healthcare, and public facilities. Each seat is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with an ergonomic shape for comfort.
The seats attach to a continuous seam welded steel frame with tamper-resistant hardware through molded-in threaded steel inserts. Choose 1 to 4 seats, without arms, with arms at the ends, or with arms between every seat, and set the frame on tamper-resistant glides or bolt it to the floor.
Seats: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene with an antimicrobial compound
Seat Attachment: Molded-in threaded steel inserts give a tamper-resistant, steel-to-steel attachment to the frame
Frame: Continuous seam welded 2” diameter, 14-gauge powder coated steel with 11-gauge steel seat supports
Configurations: 1, 2, 3, or 4 seats
Arms: No arms, arms at the ends, or arms between every seat
Tables: Optional table attachments, with variable table placement
Height: 36”
Static Load: 2,000 lbs
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
10 – 1 Seat: No arms
20 – 2 Seats: No arms
30 – 3 Seats: No arms
40 – 4 Seats: No arms
22 – 2 Seats: Arms at the ends
32 – 3 Seats: Arms at the ends
42 – 4 Seats: Arms at the ends
23 – 2 Seats: Arms between every seat
34 – 3 Seats: Arms between every seat
45 – 4 Seats: Arms between every seat
Installation and Options
Floor Glides or Bolt-Down: Frames come with tamper-resistant, nylon-bottom floor glides or a bolt-to-floor option
Floor Glide Installation: Each glide is anchored with a ¼”-16×3¾” anchor bolt, flat washer, and security Torx set screw (included), in a hole at least 2” deep; see Cortech instructions
Hardware: The seats attach to the frame with tamper-resistant screws (T40 bit)
[H2] Applications
Structured Seating suits waiting areas and common rooms where seating has to stay in rows, stand up to heavy use, and be easy to clean.
Typical applications include:
Lobbies and waiting rooms in correctional facilities and police stations
Dayrooms and common areas in jails and detention centers
Behavioral healthcare facilities and other public waiting areas
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (59 characters): Cortech Structured Seating Beam Seating System at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop Cortech Structured Seating. Molded polyethylene beam seating in 1 to 4 seat layouts, with or without arms, on a welded steel frame for lobbies.
Notes and Questions
Series section: Structured Seating is not part of the Cortech Endurance Series, so this page has no series section, only the About Cortech paragraph.
H1: I took out the dashes and "Rotationally Molded Design." Cortech does not publish model numbers for Structured Seating (the spec sheet says to contact Cortech for ordering information), so I kept your configuration numbers (10 to 45) under Available Models and Options and did not add them to the H1.
Variant name: "42 - 3 seats, with arms" should be "42 - 4 seats, with arms." Your page description and the variant weight (147 lbs, the same as the other 4-seat variants) both say 4 seats. Would you like it renamed?
Static load: your current page says 1,500 lb static load. The Cortech spec sheet says 2,000 lbs, so I used the spec sheet.
Testing: your current page says "Passes ASTM F1561-03." The Cortech spec sheet and web page do not say this, so I left it out.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 3 years, but the Cortech web page says 5 years. I used the spec sheet. Which would you like?
Colors: your current page lists 7 colors and the Cortech web page lists 12. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the spec sheet.
GREENGUARD Gold: this comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention it.
Layouts: your current page says the seating can be used in straight, U-shaped, or corner L arrangements. Cortech does not say this, so I left it out.
Dimensions: the Cortech spec drawing shows a 36” height and 19½” at the base. Cortech does not publish widths or weights. Your variants are set to 35, 62, 80, and 147 lbs, so I left them as they are.
Antimicrobial: the Cortech spec sheet says "Now infused with Cor-X antimicrobial compound," so I added "with an antimicrobial compound" to the Seats bullet.
Product images: the page has one image. Cortech has a photo of a 4-seat unit with arms between every seat. Would you like me to add it?
